Omni changes are limited to reusable embedding hooks (custom transport factory,
optional protected uTLS dialing, MTU cap) and the independently written
cmd/omni-client Android process wrapper. No vaydns-mobile or SlipNet code or
binary is included: the vaydns-mobile repository carries no license file.
